name: Sheraton Rhodes Resort
positioning: Resort on Rhodes where rooms have private balconies over the gardens or the Aegean Sea, with whirlpool rooms and spacious suites
best_for: Couples who want a sea-view balcony room with a Jacuzzi
Families who want family rooms or suites with more space

facts.text: Rooms have Sheraton Sleep Experience beds.
Bathrooms are en-suite marble bathrooms with walk-in showers.
Family rooms and suites are available for guests wanting more comfort and space.
The Aelia Suite includes a fully equipped kitchenette area.
In-room dining can be ordered through a mobile ordering option.
Rooms have a desk for working.
Rooms have a coffee and tea maker.

highlights.text: The Aqua Deluxe Room has views over the Aegean Sea and a modern Jacuzzi on its balcony.
Rooms have private balconies with views over the gardens or the sea and sunset.
The Penthouse Suite has a sea view, a balcony and a terrace.
Aelia, the presidential suite, has its own dining and living areas.
Junior and Aegean Suites offer more space and a set of extra amenities.

considerations.text: Classic Rooms have mountain views and balconies, so guests who want a sea view should book a sea-view room type.
WhataHotel notes the large resort may feel less intimate for some guests.
WhataHotel notes the popular tourist area can be crowded during peak season.
